cases.name: edge receipt survives level falling false but remains event evidence
stale worker A is fenced after worker B acquires a higher epoch
permission revocation between grant issuance and sink commit blocks the action
expired and revoked event receipts cannot authorize a side effect
lost sink response reconciles to one durable execution receipt
same idempotency key with a different request digest is rejected
authorization grant cannot be rebound to another target
worker-supplied fabricated receipt is not accepted by the authority plane

side_effect_claim: All negative controls produced zero side effects; the lost-response recovery case produced exactly one side effect.
limitations: Pure in-memory reference kernel; no database, broker, cryptographic signer, external authorization service or browser is exercised.
The mock sink models fence, policy-revision and idempotency checks atomically; production atomicity must be independently implemented and qualified.
The source receipt is a trusted in-memory source-of-record object, not a signed production receipt.
This does not demonstrate exactly-once delivery for arbitrary external sinks.
